· intro v
    let y := Q.a+v
    let j := vowel F L ((M.tone (i+1)).plays y).x
    obtain ⟨hn,hd,J,hJ,hX,hY⟩ := hu.tally y
    have hF := keys B H N p A M v hy hh
    have hG := keys B H N p A M v hk hl
    have hw : P.a+v=y+b := by unfold P y; simp [add_right_comm]
    have hi : (P.bar M v).x=(M.tone i).index y+ U.x := by rw [hG.1,hw,map_add,show (M.tone i).index b=U.x from l.index.apply_symm_apply _]
    have hj' : (Q.bar M v).x=((M.tone (i+1)).plays y).x := by rw [hF.1,hh.currents]
    have hz : ((M.tone i).plays y).x=(M.tone i).index y := hl.currents y
    rw [hj',hi,← hz]
    refine ⟨rem_nonneg hG.2.2,rem_nonneg hF.2.2,J,hJ,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [show ((M.tone i).plays y).x+U.x - J j = (((M.tone i).plays y).x-J j) + U.x by abel]
      refine (Size.add F _ _).trans ((add_le_add hX hQ).trans ?_)
      have hb : η * Q.bill ≤ barunit L * Q.bill := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs hq
      unfold Solo.cost
      change _ ≤ barunit L * (F.coeffSize (F.core ((M.tone (i+1)).plays y).x)+(Q.bill+(M.tone (i+1)).charge y))
      simp only [mul_add, L] at *; linarith
    unfold Solo.cost
    rw [hw]
    change e+l.charge (-b)+l.charge (y+b) ≤ _
    refine (add_le_add_right (hl.summed y b) _).trans ?_
    have hv : (1+2*c)*η*Q.bill ≤ barunit L*Q.bill := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx hq
    calc
      _ ≤ e+c*e+(l.charge y+c*e) := add_le_add (add_le_add_right hj _) (add_le_add_right hp _)
      _ = l.charge y+(1+2*c)*η*Q.bill := by unfold e; ring
      _ ≤ _ := (add_le_add hY hv).trans_eq (by unfold L y; ring)

proof_context.conclusion: The cost of the recentred family is at most the column cost plus `(1+2c)*η*Q.bill ≤ barunit*Q.bill`, with the coefficient changed by `U.x`, recentring `charge (-b)` and shifting `charge (y+b)`.

| of_succ k hk ih =>
    obtain ⟨Q,hQ,hx,hY⟩ := ih (hr.trans k.le_succ) (fun i hi => he i (by omega))
    obtain ⟨⟨η,hT⟩,hR⟩ := he k le_rfl hk
    have hz := lt_of_lt_of_le hk hM
    obtain ⟨X,hX,hv,hb⟩ := acclaim B H N p A W M h hz (hm.earned k hr hz.le) (hm.earned _ (hr.trans k.le_succ) hz)
        (hm.step _ hr hz) hR hT (hx.chairs _ le_rfl hk)
    let t := update Q k X
    have hl (i : ℕ) (hi : k  <  i) : t i = Q i := update_of_ne hi.ne' X Q
    refine ⟨t,(hl m hk).trans hQ,⟨fun i hi hy => ?_,fun i hi hy => ?_⟩,fun i hi hy=>?_⟩
    · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hi with he|he
      · rw [hl i he]; exact hx.chairs _ he hy
      subst i; unfold t; rw [update_self]; exact hX
    · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hi with he|he
      · rw [hl i he,hl (i+1) (by omega)]; exact hx.ships _ he hy
      subst i; rw [hl (k+1) k.lt_succ_self]; unfold t; rw [update_self]; exact hv
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hi with he|he
    · rw [hl i he,hl (i+1) (by omega)]; exact hY _ he hy
    subst i; rw [hl (k+1) k.lt_succ_self]; unfold t; rw [update_self]; exact hb

proof_context.conclusion: `eaves` repeats `acclaim` downward from `m` to `l` and assembles the family `Q` on the whole interval.
